hypothesis: Accumulate all FP16 reductions in row-major res_tile, then transpose the complete result into dead W_0_tile after its final communication callbacks. Export the named column-major res output from W_0_tile itself so no final scratch-to-output copy is needed. Input W and output res share a physical allocation in disjoint lifetime intervals under the fixed cold one-iteration contract. Preserve all outputs, workload, PE grid and timer boundaries.
falsification: Reject missing communication/reduction terms or outputs, changed precision/workload/PE/timer contracts, premature scratch reuse, numerical or clean-shutdown failures, changed full/fresh source/evaluator identity. Record cycles and program-object memory for every correct full/fresh point. Default conservative promotion additionally requires >=1.05x speedup and <=1.10x memory; the separate Pareto report keeps qualified memory tradeoffs even when that policy rejects them.
